text:
jen-platform: heads-up — i'm planning a small console change rolling tonight at 21:00 PT. it's just the help-center link in the header + a minor css tweak. low-risk but want a quick handoff and cache prime before traffic picks up.

sam_t: ack. which assets will change? do we need a full CDN invalidation or just the header bundle? :thinking_face:

alex_chan: header bundle will get a new hash (help-link.js + header.css). i'd prefer targeted paths, not a full invalidation. saves time and avoids edge thrash.

maria-g: pinging @sam_t — can you do canary monitoring for the first 30m? check 200s on /console and the header link resolves for logged-in users. i'll watch Sentry for regressions. :eyes: 

jen-platform: thanks. planned steps: 
1) deploy to canary slot B (10% traffic) at 21:00 PT
2) run smoke script against canary: `./scripts/smoke-console.sh --slot=B`
3) if green, promote at 21:10 PT to 50% then full at 21:30 PT
4) post-promotion invalidate `/console/header*` and `/assets/header-help-link.*.js` on CloudFront (targeted)

sam_t: got it. what's the exact invalidation command you want me to run?

jen-platform: use this for the targeted invalidation — i tested locally: 
```
aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E3ABCDEF12GHI --paths "/console/header*" "/assets/header-help-link.*.js"
```
note: double-check the dist id in the runbook (it's E3ABCDEF12GHI for prod-us).

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy: service=console user=jen-platform slot=B time=1767807600 (21:00 PT)

alex_chan: smoke script contents for visibility (one-liner): `curl -s -D - https://console.redwood.ai/ | grep -i "help center"` — should return the new link. also check `X-Cache` header to confirm edge hit.

maria-g: rollback plan: if anything >= 5% error rate or link missing for >2% of sessions, rollback to tag `release/2026-03-17-helplink-prev` via: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/console --to-revision=42` and then invalidate the same paths again to clear inconsistent edges.

sam_t: i'll be standing by. i'll tail `console-access.log` and watch the canary dashboard in the console (canary slot B). will post a thumbs-up if smoke passes. :thumbsup:

jen-platform: perfect. last check — are there any customers on dedicated capacity that need a separate purge? i think only hosted, yes?

alex_chan: only hosted console clusters use that CloudFront dist. Dedicated customers have their own deployments. no action needed.

maria-g: adding a quick postmortem note to the deploy checklist for audit: `help-link update - assets changed: header bundle + css - rollback tag: release/2026-03-17-helplink-prev`

sam_t: smoke pass at 21:03 PT on slot B — header link resolves, `X-Cache: Hit` on most requests. pushing to 50%.

j en-platform: (typo corrected) jen-platform: promoted to 50% at 21:12 PT, monitoring.

maria-g: metrics look clean so far, no Sentry regressions in the last 8 minutes.

sam_t: full rollout at 21:29 PT complete. did the targeted invalidation at 21:32 PT. logs look normal. :white_check_mark:

jen-platform: awesome — thanks everyone. i'll close the ticket and add notes to release doc. if anything crops up overnight tag me @jen-platform. :slightly_smiling_face:
